source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of experimental design (PDF 204-205).

items: Tajarbe ka sawal likhein jo tay karta hai ke aap kya jaanna chahte hain.
Hypothesis banayein: maujooda ilm ki bunyad par kya hone ki tawaqqo hai.
Variables pehchanein: kya badlenge (independent), kya naapenge (dependent) aur kya aik jaisa rakhenge (control).
Groups banayein: baghair ilaaj ke control group aur ilaaj ke saath experimental group.
Tareeqa tafseel se tay karein: subjects kaise chune aur groups mein bante jayenge, har group ke saath kya hoga, naap ki muddat aur baar, aur data kaise jama hoga.
Tajziya: groups ke muqable aur wazeh asar jaanchne ke liye ausat, graphs ya statistical tests use karein.
Nateeja: nataij ko hypothesis aur sawal se jorein, aur hypothesis qubool ya radd karein.

blocks.text: Hal shuda misaal: albino chuhon mein zyada charbi wali ghiza aur wazan

items: Sawal: kya zyada charbi wali ghiza chuhon mein aam ghiza se zyada wazan barhati hai?
Hypothesis: zyada charbi wali ghiza wale chuhe aam ghiza walon se zyada wazan barhayenge.
Variables: independent, ghiza ki qisam; dependent, wazan ka barhna; control, chuhon ki umr, nasl, jins, pinjra, mahol (roshni, darja hararat) aur khurak ka waqt.
Groups: aam ghiza wala control group; zyada charbi wala experimental group.

Tareeqa: umr, nasl aur jins mein milte albino chuhe chunein; unhein ittefaqan groups mein baantein; sab ko aik jaise halaat mein rakhein; har group ko muqarrar muddat, maslan 8 hafte, apni ghiza dein; har chuhe ka har hafte wazan karein.
Tajziya: aakhir mein graphs ya statistical tests se dono groups ke ausat wazan barhne ka muqabla karein.

Nateeja: agar zyada charbi wala group shumariyati taur par wazeh zyada barhe to hypothesis ki taeed; agar wazeh farq na ho, ya aam ghiza wala zyada barhe, to radd, yaani in halaat mein doosre awamil zyada ahem hain.

blocks.prompt: Chuhon ko groups mein ittefaqan kyun baanta jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taa ke alag alag chuhon ke farq dono groups mein barabar bat jayein aur sirf ghiza ka farq baqi rahe; is se test munsifana aur ghair janibdar rehta hai.

items: Saat qadam: sawal, hypothesis, variables, groups, tareeqa, tajziya, nateeja.
Chuhon ki misaal: ghiza (independent), wazan (dependent), control aur zyada charbi groups, ittefaqi taqseem, 8 hafte.
